title: Cosmopsychism is the more plausible constitutive panpsychism

statements.text: On cosmopsychism a human consciousness is an aspect of the consciousness of the universe, grounded by subsumption, so it can be part of reality in itself and need not be deflated. Those who want the benefits of constitutive panpsychism are directed to cosmopsychism.

sources.quote: The crucial advantage of cosmopsychism, as opposed to micropsychism, is that it does not require a deflationary view of o-subjects and their experiences.
If we want to take advantage of the theoretical benefits of constitutive panpsychism, then we should embrace cosmopsychism.
